hope.speaker: Margaret
hope.text: You gave Sarah something she can repeat to the kids. Harold will want numbers before supper. The ledger is on the west table when you are ready.

forgiveness.speaker: Margaret
forgiveness.text: Frank stayed through it. He did not clap. That is new. The ledger is on the west table. I did not want it before the hymn.

service.speaker: Margaret
service.text: Thomas heard a list, and Harold heard permission to fix things. The ledger is on the west table. Lists do not pay the oil bill.

plain.speaker: Margaret
plain.text: The room stayed. That is the whole victory. The ledger is on the west table when you want the rest of it.

again.speaker: Margaret
again.text: The ledger is on the west table. I will not read it out loud in the aisle.
